agent_explanation: With e=1 and no controller work, energy should be conserved, but a high-speed (~59) impact against the thin vertical wall injects energy: speed grows from ~58.85 at step 4 to ~66.7 at step 5 and energy from ~1817 to ~2310. The body approaches the wall's side/edge region and the impulse plus positional correction over-corrects, reversing vx and spuriously boosting vy (from -16.15 to +53.78), i.e. a corner/sequential-impulse energy gain. Setting e=0 removes the gain and the run passes.
